page.overview:
What is Taser?

A [https://en.m.wikipedia.org/wiki/Taser Taser] is an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Electroshock_weapon electroshock weapon] that uses electrical current to disrupt voluntary control of muscles.

In the franchise, befitting his occupation as Law Enforcement, Officer Kurtis Stryker would frequently make use of tasers in his special moves and Fatalities. In Mortal Kombat (2011), Stryker would also use his Taser in a throw and at the end of his X-Ray move.

In Mortal Kombat Mobile, Cassie Cage's Strike Force Card uses a taser for her Special 2 attack. This is the only time Cassie has ever used a taser and its use is exclusive to MK Mobile.
